description:
SAIC is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to support the design, development, and integration of embedded software systems. The selected candidate will work across the software development lifecycle, contributing to architecture development, requirements management, system analysis, design reviews, and software implementation in support of mission-critical programs in Huntsville, AL. 
 Job Duties and Responsibilities 
 The Software Developer will perform a broad range of engineering activities, independently or under general supervision, supporting the design, development, integration, and implementation of software systems and related technologies.
 Job Description 
 Key responsibilities include:
 Developing system and software architectures for embedded systems
 Managing and analyzing software requirements
 Designing, developing, and implementing embedded software solutions
 Reviewing system and subsystem specifications, interface documentation, and design artifacts for completeness, accuracy, and applicability
 Supporting system and subsystem design activities, trade studies, and performance analyses
 Interpreting and analyzing customer requirements
 Reviewing, verifying, and validating system specifications and other technical documentation
 Participating in hardware and software design reviews, technical interchange meetings, management reviews, and configuration control boards
 

 Education Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline and five (5) years of relevant professional experience; Additional six (6) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree (per contract vehicle)
 Clearance Requirements 
 Must have the ability to obtain a Secret security clearance
 Active Secret clearance preferred
 US Citizenship required
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience developing software in C++ within an embedded environment
 Proficiency in object-oriented analysis and design using Unified Modeling Language (UML)
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, documentation standards, and CMMI methodologies
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with VxWorks
 Experience using IBM Rhapsody
 Experience using IBM DOORS
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
